channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 05
item.description:
72 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Item drop and pickup notifications now work correctly for right‑to‑left languages.
  • Crafting notices display correctly in RTL languages.

UI & Localization

  • Item drop and pickup notifications now work correctly for right‑to‑left languages.
  • Crafting notices display correctly in RTL languages.

Gameplay Limits & Power

  • Softcore servers now cap placed Tool Cupboards to three, with an on‑screen warning when the limit is reached.
  • Generators only draw electricity while actively producing biofuel, eliminating idle power drain.

Livestock

  • Livestock age progression bug fixed: animals no longer lose age or regress when growing from calf to adult.
  • Leash distance increased to 15 m and animals now display familiarity and gender by default.
  • Sale penalty for selling bought or found animals to the livestock vendor raised from 20 % to 85 %.

Transportation

  • Fixed motorcycle dismount order, ensuring players dismount in the correct sequence.
  • Fixed client‑side sail wind behavior, improving sailing control and consistency.

Character Customization

  • Added an underwear category to the character creator, expanding customization options.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 04
item.description:
13 development commits

Softcore Mode

  • Fixed death screen on first softcore join; players now spawn directly at the beach.

Research & Crafting

  • Research tables can now be used to research Animal Fence and Gate.

Farming & Food

  • Milk can be stacked when the skim timer is under 1 minute, and skimming works even if food spoiling is disabled.

Vehicles

  • Scrap helicopter dismount points adjusted to avoid always ejecting players from the front.
